name: AirWolf Mod
summary: Fictional AirWolf helicopter mod built on the UH-60L mod's EFM, made standalone.
description: Flyable fictional AirWolf helicopter based on Kinkkujuustovoileipä's UH-60L v1.4 EFM, modified to run standalone. Copy the `AirWolf` folder to `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\Aircraft` and the `Config` folder into `Saved Games\DCS`.
